feed.title: Junior Thuram Nana — Updates
feed.subtitle: Milestones from SIGIL SARL by Junior Thuram Nana.

entry.title: VIGIL enters paid pilot
entry.summary: VIGIL, SIGIL's governed cybersecurity and evidence platform, is in a paid pilot. Work flows Protect → Assess → Lead-vs-fact → Remediate → Dossier; a deterministic Oracle re-verifies each observation, confirmed facts are signed, and an engagement closes with one tamper-evident dossier that re-verifies offline. VIGIL Sovereign deploys on-premise or in the client's cloud, with the client holding the keys and data.

entry.title: APEX in pre-deployment
entry.summary: APEX, SIGIL's anti-corruption intelligence system for public procurement, is in pre-deployment.

entry.title: RÉCOR demonstrated to Open Ownership
entry.summary: RÉCOR, SIGIL's beneficial-ownership registry built to the Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS v0.4), was demonstrated to and acknowledged by Open Ownership on 1 July 2026. The system is in pre-deployment.
